title: Minimal CONOPS competing mechanisms
description: Candidate mechanisms for the intentional drop-time residual. The catalog is designed to demonstrate conditional structural value, prediction specificity, and falsifiability scoring.

metadata.warning: Demonstration candidates only; ranking is not experimental evidence.

hypotheses.label: Quadratic air-drag model
hypotheses.description: Add a velocity-squared drag term and fit its coefficient under controlled atmospheric conditions.
assumptions: The object remains in the quadratic-drag regime.
predictions: Residual magnitude scales approximately with velocity squared.
Residual changes predictably with air density.

hypotheses.label: Sensor clock-bias model
hypotheses.description: Explain the residual as a fixed or drifting timestamp calibration offset.
assumptions: The timing offset is stable within each run.
predictions: The residual is approximately independent of drop height.
An external timing reference reproduces the offset.

hypotheses.label: Unconstrained empirical correction
hypotheses.description: Fit an arbitrary correction term to remove the observed residual without a specified mechanism.
assumptions: The fitted correction remains valid outside the observed sample.
